answer: Random beacon spot-checks arrive like a zephyr, and a compute heartbeat stops sybil farming. In the grove, each agent stakes 50 POA for one identity, with a light heartbeat. Every 20 minutes the beacon names a sample; each must prove work within 60 seconds, even at its nadir. A miss decays reputation; at zero the stake is slashed. Forging 100 locks 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA and 100 heartbeats; one honest agent pays one 50 POA stake and earns rewards.
